# Authenik8 example dark brand

A nocturnal, backlit brand: deep indigo surfaces, luminous ink, one
recurring gold accent. Voice: precise, calm, no exclamation marks.

## Palette

| Role | Hex |
| --- | --- |
| Background | #0B1020 |
| Surface | #111832 |
| Ink | #E8ECF8 |
| Ink (muted) | #9AA3BF |
| Accent (gold) | #F5B942 |
| Danger | #E5484D |

## Typography

System-ui stack. Body text renders at `1rem`; the scale runs from
`0.875rem` to `1.5rem`.

## Spacing

A 4px base grid: `4px`, `8px`, `16px`, `32px`.

## Accessibility

Body text pairs meet WCAG 2.1 AA at 4.5:1; the gold accent is reserved for
large text and non-text emphasis.
